offline_budget.integer_validation: Python int only; reject bool, float, string and numpy integer scalar
offline_budget.semantics: Budget counts exactly one declared primary optimizer.step() per update; scheduled actor/auxiliary calls count separately in total steps and per-optimizer counts
offline_budget.closed_form_budget: inapplicable; zero actual optimizer steps; no artificial repeat loops

evaluation.final_scoring_policy: frozen snapshot after the declared adaptation phase

online_budget.interactions_and_updates: nonnegative Python int, not bool or float
online_budget.batch_size: positive Python int, not bool or float
online_budget.learning_settings: explicit finite JSON-compatible dict; host validates supported fields

adapter.primary_optimizer: required nonempty optimizer counter key for optimizer_steps semantics; None for closed_form
adapter.full_checkpoint_frequency: phase boundaries; never serialize a full neural checkpoint per atomic update
adapter.update_auxiliary_optimizer_steps: according to declared host schedule; count separately without consuming primary budget
adapter.affine_sgd_reference_scope: real SGD plumbing reference, not neural BCA or a host neural learner

transitions.actions: actual executed actions after action transforms
transitions.group_ids: integer or fixed-width string identifiers preserving group provenance

checkpoint.not_applicable_declaration: metadata.not_applicable_components; explicit component bytes with reason still required
checkpoint.counts: nonnegative Python ints; optimizer_steps is TOTAL=sum(optimizer_step_counts); primary count is optimizer_step_counts[metadata.primary_optimizer]
checkpoint.primary_optimizer_declaration: metadata.primary_optimizer for optimizer-based hosts; must agree with capabilities.primary_optimizer
checkpoint.metadata: internally immutable canonical JSON; public property returns defensive deep copy
checkpoint.serialization: versioned JSON and base64, no pickle; reject duplicate keys; verify payload and component digests
checkpoint.save: exclusive create; never overwrite an existing destination
checkpoint.resumption: retain model, every optimizer, targets, all RNGs including sampler, preprocessing, action transforms, learning schedules and lineage
checkpoint.integrity_limit: presence and hashes are cooperative integrity, not proof of completeness or truthfulness

receipt_requirements.online_scope: budget.requested and requested_primary_optimizer_updates_per_family are per family; top-level requested_primary_optimizer_updates and executed counters aggregate families
receipt_requirements.resumption_counts: report both checkpoint cumulative totals and newly executed steps
receipt_requirements.mixture: report requested offline fraction and actual offline/online sample counts

frozen_boundary.runner_checkpoint_directory: optional run_mode keyword; CLI and shipped example provide it
frozen_boundary.saved_checkpoint_evaluation: save all scenario endpoints exclusively, reload and verify digests, restore loaded state before any frozen evaluation
frozen_boundary.without_checkpoint_directory: Python test path reports in_memory_snapshot; does not claim saved-checkpoint evaluation
frozen_boundary.guard: cooperative InferenceGuard hooks for supported training, collection and Python write paths
frozen_boundary.checkpoint_io: save, reload, verify and restore before the frozen guard starts
frozen_boundary.artifact_writes: result artifacts after guarded rollout; endpoint checkpoints before the frozen guard starts
